stock.title: Stock at {{store}}
stock.lead: Check and adjust how many units of each product your store holds.

employment.denied: Your account does not manage the stock of any store.

filters.title: Filter
filters.skuHint: Capitals, digits and hyphens. For example, ABC-123.
filters.qHint: For when you do not know the SKU by heart.

empty.stocked: This store does not hold any product yet.
empty.stockedFiltered: No product in stock matches the search.
empty.notStocked: Every catalog product is already added to this store.
empty.notStockedFiltered: No product left to add matches the search.

edit.title: Change units
edit.quantityHint: Zero is a valid value: the product stays managed in this store.
edit.gone: That line no longer exists: someone removed it from the stock while you were editing it.

conflict.title: Someone changed this line
conflict.body: Another employee saved a different value while you were editing. Decide which one stands.

delete.title: Remove from stock
delete.body: You are about to delete the line for “{{product}}” at {{store}}. The product will stop being managed here and will go back to the list of those not added yet.
delete.notZero: This is not the same as setting the units to zero: with zero the line stays and the product is still managed in this store.

newLine.title: Add stock
newLine.lead: Find the product by its SKU and say how many units {{store}} holds.

sku.label: Product SKU
sku.hint: Capitals, digits and hyphens. For example, ABC-123.

quantity.label: Units at {{store}}
quantity.hint: Zero is a valid value: it adds the product with no units yet.

duplicate.title: That product already has a line in this store
duplicate.body: “{{product}}” is already added at {{store}}. What you are after is changing its units.

validation.sku: A SKU is 3 to 32 characters: capitals, digits and hyphens.
validation.skuNotFound: There is no active product with that SKU. It may not exist, or it may be discontinued.
validation.quantity: Units are a whole number of 0 or more.

admin.title: Administration
admin.lead: What only an administrator account can do.

products.title: Products
products.body: The global catalog: create, edit, photograph, discontinue and delete.

products.title: Products
products.lead: The catalog is global and belongs to no store. Discontinued products show up here too.

filters.title: Filter and sort
filters.qHint: Accents and capitals do not matter.
filters.statusHint: A discontinued product only shows up if you ask for it here.

empty.none: There are no products in the catalog yet.

form.skuHint: 3 to 32 characters: capitals, digits and hyphens. It is set now and never changed.
form.skuFixed: The SKU cannot be edited: it is the identifier printed on the label. Changing it would mean creating another product.
form.name: Name
form.descriptionHint: Free text. It is what the customer reads on the product page.
form.priceHint: In euros, two decimals at most. For example, 399.99.

new.title: New product
new.lead: The product is born in the catalog and without a photo. The photo is uploaded afterwards, on its own page.

duplicate.title: That SKU belongs to another product
duplicate.body: «{{sku}}» is already taken. A SKU belongs to one product for life, even if that product is discontinued.

image.title: Photo
image.description: Optional, and apart from the rest of the form: it is uploaded and removed on its own.
image.rules: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. The new one replaces the previous one.

rejected.type: That file is not a JPEG, a PNG or a WebP.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.activeBody: Discontinuing deletes nothing: the product leaves the catalog and the stock screens, its orders stay as they are, and you can put it back whenever you want.
catalog.discontinuedBody: It is out of the catalog. Reactivating it brings it back to the shop and to the stock screens.

delete.sectionBody: Only a product that has never been used can be deleted. If it is already in an order, in a store's stock or in a cart, the answer is to discontinue it.
delete.title: Delete product
delete.body: You are about to delete «{{product}}» and its photo. This cannot be undone.
delete.notDiscontinue: This is not the same as discontinuing: discontinuing keeps the product and its history, and can be reversed.

inUse.title: This product cannot be deleted
inUse.wayOut: The way out is to discontinue it: it stops being sold and stops showing up in stock, and everything already pointing at it stays as it is.

validation.name: The name is required and 255 characters at most.
validation.price: The price is an amount in euros with two decimals at most. For example, 399.99.
validation.skuTaken: That SKU belongs to another product.
validation.typeGone: That type no longer exists. Pick another one.
